verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials are a fair axis for a SaaS platform with a public API. However, the evidence pack only documents the Marketing Emails API endpoints, a CLI and an official MCP server, with nothing about token scopes, private-app permissions or per-agent credential restriction. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
